title: Upstream: dartsv 3.0.0 HDPrivateKey child derivation throws 'Too few elements' for 1 in 256 keys (leading zero); libspiffy works around it with lib/src/utils/bip32.dart

Public derivation works, so wallets hand out addresses they cannot sign for. Repro: mnemonic 'crouch better box major secret tool wish fresh session brand series disease' TEST, m.deriveChildKey('m/1/0'); also 'abandon ... about' m/0/113, m/0/349, m/0/945. Suggested patch: pad keyBytes into paddedKey at 33-len; depth = parent+1; I_L/zero/infinity checks; copy networkType. Once fixed upstream, Bip32 may delegate to dartsv (tests: test/crypto/bip32_test.dart vectors 1-4 + seeded equivalence). Also: several tests still call dartsv deriveChildKey/deriveChildNumber directly with fixed non-short inputs (channel_test_fixtures, payment_channel_manager tests, spv_actor_bump_index) — move to Bip32/crypto service.
